title: Customer mail
subtitle: Offers, contracts and other mail to customers leave only from a mailbox of your business – Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace. When a person has connected their own mailbox, their mail goes from there; otherwise from the business's mailbox. With none connected, the app cannot send customer mail.
loadError: The customer mail settings could not be loaded.

business.heading: Business mailbox
business.none: No business mailbox is connected yet.
business.connectHint: Then sign in at the provider as an administrator of your organisation.
business.disconnectNote: This disconnects in Nexotec only. The consent in your organisation stays until your IT removes the «Nexotec» app there.
business.providerNotConfigured: Nexotec has not set up this provider yet.
business.readOnly: Only a manager can connect or disconnect the business mailbox.

granted.microsoft_365_mail: You allow the «Nexotec» app to send mail in your Microsoft 365 organisation. Microsoft grants this for every mailbox of your organisation. Nexotec sends only from the mailbox you connect here. Nexotec reads no mail.
granted.google_workspace_mail: Your administrator allows Nexotec's service account, in the Google Admin console, to send mail (domain-wide delegation, «gmail.send» only). Google grants this for every mailbox of your domain. Nexotec sends only from the mailbox you connect here. Nexotec reads no mail.

business.restrictTitle: How your IT restricts the permission

restrict.microsoft_365_mail: Your IT can restrict the permission to this one mailbox in Exchange Online: with «RBAC for Applications» (or the older application access policy) for the «Nexotec» app.
restrict.google_workspace_mail: Your IT sets up the domain-wide delegation with the «gmail.send» scope only and can restrict it to an organisational unit holding just this mailbox.

own.heading: My mailbox
own.intro: Connect your own mailbox so customers get your mail from you and replies reach you. Sent mail appears in your «Sent» folder.
own.none: You have not connected your own mailbox yet.
own.privacy: Nexotec only sends on your behalf and reads no mail. Your manager does not see your address.
